Card Q&A.q: Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect give "can't unsuspend" to a card that was not suspended by it?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, by placing your deck's top card face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, for each of this Digimon's face-down digivolution cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon are played, you may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
